El método de reducción de [[al-sistemas]: The elimination method of [[al-sistemas]] consisted of adding equations multiplied by numbers so that one unknown disappeared. Gauss is exactly that, done in an orderly way and on the matrix of the system, so that it works the same with three unknowns as with a hundred. The row operations used here are the ones you already know from determinants.
Con dos ecuaciones y dos incógnitas, sus: With two equations and two unknowns, substitution or elimination is enough. With three, four or a hundred, you need a systematic method: something that can be followed mechanically without thinking, and that can also be programmed. That method is Gauss's.
La idea es escribir el sistema como una: The idea is to write the system as a table of numbers (the augmented matrix) and transform it, with operations that do not change the solutions, until it is in echelon form: with zeros below the diagonal.

El método de Gauss consiste en ir simpli: Gauss's method consists of simplifying the system until it reads itself, and for that there are three legal moves. What matters is not memorising them but understanding why they are legal: none of the three changes the solutions, they only change the way they are written. It is the same licence you had with the balance scale, now applied to several equations at once.

Gauss desarrolló su método hacia 1809 po: Gauss developed his method around 1809 out of a very concrete need: the asteroid Ceres had just appeared and been lost, with only a few observations before it hid behind the Sun. Gauss fitted its orbit by solving an enormous system by elimination, predicted where it would reappear and got it right. He was twenty-four and it made him famous throughout Europe.
El teorema que formaliza todo esto compa: The theorem that formalises all this compares the rank of the coefficient matrix with that of the augmented one. The rank is the number of non-zero rows left after reducing:

$\operatorname{rank}(A)$ is said “rank of A”: the number of rows that do not vanish on reducing. $A^*$ is said “A augmented” and is the matrix with the column of constant terms attached.

It reads: “if the rank of A differs from the rank of A augmented, the system is inconsistent”.

In plain words: if on reducing a row appears saying “zero equals something other than zero”, the system contradicts itself and no solution is possible.
El método de Gauss es probablemente el a: Gauss's method is probably the most executed algorithm in engineering. Working out the stresses in a structure, the current in each branch of a circuit, how flow is shared in a network of pipes or how heat spreads through a part always ends in a system of many equations solved this way. With thousands of unknowns nobody does it by hand, but the computer carries out exactly the steps you are learning.
Cada ecuación con tres incógnitas es un: Each equation in three unknowns is a plane in space, and solving the system is looking for the points lying on all three at once. The three endings of the discussion have a direct geometric translation: consistent and determinate, the three planes meet at a point; indeterminate, they share a line (or a whole plane); inconsistent, there is no point common to all three. The relative positions of lines and planes are studied in depth in [[ge-espacio]], and discussion with a parameter in [[al-discusion]].
